name: Quantum ESPRESSO
summary: An open-source suite for electronic-structure calculations; this Hub bundle models the pinned PWscf regression inputs.
scope: Reusable DIPL schemas and native pw.x generation for all 27 inputs in the pinned test-suite/pw_scf directory: SCF, NSCF, and bands cases.
validation_qualifier: On 2026-10-09, all 27 generated inputs matched pinned PWscf regression references under a semantic comparison; 36 project tests passed. A pinned pw.x build and si_scf smoke run completed on macOS. Scientific-result validation is not claimed.
limitations: The scope is the 27 pinned PWscf regression inputs, not all pw.x features or other QE executables. Twenty-five recipes need pseudopotentials or preceding workflow state and are native-inputs-only. A local macOS build and si_scf smoke run completed, but other platforms and scientific results are not validated. This independent adapter has no QE maintainer endorsement.
